searchText: Have rebased on v1.7.0-a.0 which seems to include such changes, any further blockers or okay to proceed with 7688 progressivelist changes? - https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4630 Suppose I want to analyze SSZ data that comes from RPC as binary stream and need human readable form of it. Is there any format for schema that RPC can provide along with the data? SSZ does not currently define a transmissible schema, and also uses consensus-fork-specific data structures i.e., client needs to know what to expect. server only tells them the consensus-fork that's being used (via HTTP header) From ACDC discussion, CFI non-headliners (e.g., 7688) can be merged after the headliner (ePBS) is stable on devnets. Will keep rebasing it until that is the case.
